name: Shots
summary: Nine framings of one image: wide, close-up, top-down, low angle and rotations.

source.notes: Template app written by tools/template_apps.py: the workflow is apps/relight's (built by tools/build_apps.py) with Unsloth Qwen Image Edit 2511 Q4_K_M, Lightning 2511 and fal's <sks> Multiple Angles LoRA; the prompt below is fixed and "Extra direction" is appended to it.

inputs.label: Shot
inputs.default: 将镜头转为广角镜头 Turn the camera to a wide-angle lens.

options.value: 将镜头转为广角镜头 Turn the camera to a wide-angle lens.
options.label: Wide-angle

sets.value: <sks> front view eye-level shot wide shot. Use a wide-angle lens. {details}

options.value: 将镜头转为特写镜头 Turn the camera to a close-up.
options.label: Close-up

options.value: 将镜头转为极特写镜头 Turn the camera to an extreme close-up.
options.label: Extreme close-up

sets.value: <sks> front view eye-level shot close-up. Frame only the closest detail. {details}

options.value: 将镜头转为俯视 Turn the camera to a top-down view.
options.label: Top-down

sets.value: <sks> front view high-angle shot medium shot. Frame the scene directly from overhead. {details}

options.value: 将镜头转为仰视 Turn the camera to a low-angle view looking up.
options.label: Low angle

sets.value: <sks> front view low-angle shot medium shot. {details}

options.value: 将镜头向左旋转45度 Rotate the camera 45 degrees to the left.
options.label: Rotate 45° left

sets.value: <sks> front-left quarter view eye-level shot medium shot. {details}

options.value: 将镜头向右旋转45度 Rotate the camera 45 degrees to the right.
options.label: Rotate 45° right

sets.value: <sks> front-right quarter view eye-level shot medium shot. {details}

options.value: 将镜头向左旋转90度 Rotate the camera 90 degrees to the left.
options.label: Rotate 90° left

sets.value: <sks> left side view eye-level shot medium shot. {details}

options.value: 将镜头转到人物背后 Move the camera behind the subject.
options.label: From behind

sets.value: <sks> back view eye-level shot medium shot. {details}
